name: Davis UWC Scholars Program
host: Davis UWC Scholars Program + US partner colleges
amount: Need-based aid with the partner college (often large; check each partner college)
dlText: No single deadline: apply through each partner college's regular admission and financial-aid deadlines
tags: Admission to a partner US college

eligibility.note: Any nationality, but only graduates of the 18 UWC (United World College) schools who completed the IB Diploma and are admitted to a participating US college

note: Need-based undergraduate aid for UWC graduates at 100+ US partner colleges (106 partners listed for 2026-27). Davis funding is combined with the college's own aid; you must already be a UWC graduate, so this is not open to other students.

name: Tata Scholarship at Cornell University
host: Cornell University (Tata Education and Development Trust endowment)
amount: Need-based: covers demonstrated financial need for up to 8 semesters (10 for B.Arch)
dlText: 2 Jan 2027 (Regular Decision application + international aid application; time not stated). Early Decision was 1 Nov 2026
tags: Apply for aid via CSS Profile

eligibility.note: Students who attended secondary school in India, are admitted to Cornell as first-year undergraduates and qualify for need-based aid

countryNotes.IN: You are considered automatically if you apply for admission and for financial aid (CSS Profile).

note: Endowed by the Tata trust for undergraduates from India; no separate application, you are considered when you apply to Cornell and for need-based aid. Funding lasts the whole degree while need continues.

name: King's Scholarship (Thailand) – ทุนเล่าเรียนหลวง
host: Office of the Civil Service Commission (OCSC), Thailand
amount: Full scholarship for study abroad (check official page); 9 awards in fiscal 2026 (BE 2569)
dlText: ~28 Oct 2026 (estimated from the BE 2568 cycle, which ran 3–28 Oct 2024); likely already closed
fields: Any field set by the scholarship units
note: Thailand's royal scholarship for top final-year secondary students to study abroad; selected by OCSC exam. The only obligation is to work in Thailand for as long as the scholarship lasted.

name: Zawadi Africa Educational Fund
country: Any (partner universities in the US and Africa)
amount: check official page (combined with partner-university scholarships)
dlText: ~16 Mar 2027 for Kenya (estimated from 2026 cycle; time not stated). Applications usually open Feb, close Mar–Apr

countryNotes.UG: Listed as a programme country; check whether a call is open.
countryNotes.GH: Listed as a programme country; check whether a call is open.

note: Helps academically gifted girls from disadvantaged backgrounds win scholarships at universities in the US and Africa, with mentoring and leadership training. Admission is decided by the partner universities, so an award is not guaranteed.

name: Jardine Foundation Scholarships (Oxford & Cambridge)
dlText: Postgraduate awards: apply through the partner college after provisional acceptance (dates set by each college)
tags: Partner college at Oxford or Cambridge
fields: Any course at a partner college
note: Full-ride scholarships at eight partner colleges (Downing, Magdalene, Peterhouse, Trinity at Cambridge; Exeter, Oriel, Queen's, Trinity at Oxford). Postgraduate awards (up to 4 years) are applied for through the partner colleges after provisional acceptance. Undergraduate awards are not listed here: an earlier official check found no new undergraduate awards from the 2027 intake, so confirm on the Jardine Foundation page.

name: Rise (Rise Global Winners)
amount: Need-based 4-year post-secondary scholarship (tuition + living stipend where not already covered by aid)
dlText: ~17 Jan 2027 (estimated from the 2023–24 cycle, which ran late Sep to 17 Jan; time zone not stated)
note: Global competition for 15–17-year-olds; 100 winners a year get lifelong support, including a need-based scholarship for university wherever they study. Check the site for the current cycle dates, which have shifted between years.

name: Khazanah Global Scholarship Programme
amount: Full academic fees, living expenses, accommodation + development support (check official page)
dlText: June 2027 for university entry (estimated: 'June, yearly'); A-Level route Mar–Apr; exact day not stated
note: Yayasan Khazanah's flagship scholarship for Malaysians at top universities abroad, with leadership training and job attachments in Malaysia. One official page says overseas undergraduate entry is via its A-Level route, so check which entry is open.

name: Inlaks Scholarship
amount: Tuition, living allowance, health insurance + one-way travel; up to US$100,000
fields: Social sciences, humanities, law, fine arts, architecture, maths, sciences, environment (not business, CS, engineering, film, fashion, hospitality)
note: For young Indian graduates with an offer from a top overseas institution. Minimum 65% (humanities/social sciences) or 70% (sciences); not for those who already started a postgraduate degree abroad.

name: Saïd Foundation Scholarships
amount: Tuition, full living costs, arrival allowance, visa + health surcharge, one economy return flight

countryNotes.SY: Syrians living outside Syria because of the situation there can still be considered.

fields: Any one-year master's at a UK partner university
note: Fully funded one-year master's at the Foundation's UK partner universities for people from Syria, Jordan, Lebanon and Palestine who plan to return to the region. No undergraduate or PhD funding.

name: Beit Trust Postgraduate Scholarships
amount: Full tuition, living allowance, economy flights, visa/IHS costs + arrival, laptop and departure allowances
fields: Postgraduate (mainly master's) at UK or South African partner universities
note: Fully funded master's at UK partner universities (Sept 2027 start) or South African partners (Jan 2028 start). UK applicants need an offer first; South Africa applicants may list intended universities.

name: Mandela Rhodes Scholarship
amount: Tuition, accommodation, meals, medical aid, personal allowance, study/research allowances + economy travel for international scholars
fields: Any field (Honours or Master's; no MBA, block or online courses)
note: Funds a one-year Honours or up to two-year Master's at a South African university plus a compulsory leadership programme. Final-year students can apply if they graduate by 1 Jan 2028.

name: Swire Scholarships at St Antony's College, Oxford
host: St Antony's College, University of Oxford (Swire Charitable Trust)
amount: Course fees + living-costs grant, up to 3 years
dlText: ~2 Mar 2027, 17:00 UK time (estimated from 2026 cycle); apply to Oxford by the January course deadline
fields: St Antony's graduate courses (not part-time, MBA, MFE or MPP)
note: Two fully funded graduate scholarships for Hong Kong residents at St Antony's College. You need a place by about 10 April and must intend to return to Hong Kong.
